title: HLSubstance
description: A miscellanous mod adding features such as tents & more!
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/778c35919889632f1fcb70fdfc46005f344f5cc8.png)

**HLSubstance** adds Quality of Life & miscellaneous features in a vanilla-ish style, this mod also serves as a comanion mod for my modpack **HLStuff**



**Current Features:**

- **Tents!** - Use a Tent to set up camp, sleep through the night and set a temporary spawn point. Once the tent is broken your spawn point will revert back to your bed. 

- **Reuseable Smithing Templates** - Gone are the days of having to dupelicate your templates, all smithing templates will no longer be consumed when upgrading your gear.

- Many more features to come!
